newsitem.title: UK: New hires at AIM, Caspian in London.
newsitem.headline: New hires at AIM, Caspian in London.

text.p: The Caspian Group has appointed Christopher Kirkham-Sandy as Chief Financial Officer while Anthony Meyers joins as a director of AIM Global Advisers, statements from the asset management firms said.

Kirkham-Sandy, with an industrial background in Europe and the U.S., joins Caspian immediately, succeeding Simon Leathes, who will join Hambros plc as Group Finance Director with effect from January 2.

Meyers was previously with Gartmore, where he was managing director of Gartmore Money Management Ltd. AIM Global Advisers is the London-based European cash and fund management operation of AIM management Group Inc, headquartered in Texas.
AIM recently announced a strategic merger with INVESCO plc to create a global investment group with around $150 billion assets under management.
